headline: India Flash PMI Shows Private Sector Growth Accelerating to Four-Month High
summary: India's private sector output expansion reached a four-month high in October, according to the HSBC Flash India PMI. Manufacturing and services activity expanded at a faster pace as input cost pressures eased, though employment growth moderated.
why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing major economies, and its purchasing managers' index provides key insights into corporate activity, domestic demand, and inflationary trends.
